description.value: Stong's Replenish Cafe is a ready-to-eat department within Stong's Market, a locally-owned Vancouver grocery institution on Dunbar Street. The store is notable for its breadth of grab-and-go options including award-winning rotisserie chicken, daily-made fresh sushi, artisan baked goods, and house-pressed juices. Touring cyclists can resupply with fresh local produce, hot prepared meals, and deli items all under one roof.
